images.prompt: Actual gameplay view, not poster, no device frame. A cargo-placement puzzle seen as a transverse cross-section of a wooden sailing merchant ship's hold at night: a U-shaped hull cut open like a dollhouse, three shelves of grid slots holding burlap spice sacks, bundled cinnamon sticks, clay saffron jars and wooden tea crates, each with a small parchment label. Colored scent mist drifts out of every item and bleeds into neighboring slots — slate-violet pepper, rust-orange cinnamon, plum clove, gold saffron, green tea. The player holds a tea crate over an empty slot that glows red because it touches two clove sacks; a neighboring safe slot glows green. Gold '+12%' tags link pepper and cinnamon neighbors. A hanging oil lantern gives warm amber light; dark teal sea water laps the outside of the hull. Right side: a parchment sea chart with a dashed red route and a small ship marker, and a dark wood rule card. Korean UI: title '향신료 항로', '7일째 / 14일', '정향 두 자루와 맞닿음'. Painterly illustrated style, candlelit browns and amber, jewel-toned mist, film grain, vignette. Correction: the sea chart must use only fictional port names — label the start port '소금포', a midway port '안개섬' and the destination '백단항'; do not write any real-world place names (no Calicut/칼리컷, Java/자바, India, Malacca, etc.).

Actual gameplay view, not poster, no device frame. The same ship-hold cross-section after a fourteen-day voyage, docked at a warm dusk harbor: the deck hatch is thrown open and a golden beam of light with floating dust falls into the hold. The scent mists have spread widely and blended across the grid. Every spice slot carries a price-change badge — glowing gold '+84%', '+118%' on a pepper-and-cinnamon block outlined in golden light, grey '±0' on neutral slots — while one tea crate is tinted moldy green with a red ink stamp reading '향 오염'. Right side: a large parchment unloading ledger titled '백단항 하역 장부' with strikethrough old prices, new prices, a double-ruled total '금화 2,482', a red wax seal and a small merchant portrait with a speech line. Bottom: a strip of three tiny grid maps showing the scent spread on day 1, day 7 and day 14. Korean UI: '백단항 · 14일째', '금화 3,722'. Painterly illustrated style, dusk orange and warm parchment, deep teal sea, jewel-toned haze, film grain. Correction: keep the same transverse U-shaped hull cross-section camera as image A (not a top-down crate grid). The ledger must contain exactly these 8 rows and no others (old price struck through → new price, change): 후추 120→221 +84%, 계피 180→393 +118%, 사프란 400→652 +63%, 정향 220→341 +55%, 육두구 200→272 +36%, 카다몸 180→268 +49%, 녹차 251→251 ±0, 홍차 300→84 −72% (the '향 오염' tea); the double-ruled total must read exactly '금화 2,482', which equals the sum of the new prices.
